title: Imaging on the multicamera worm tracker-Phenix
author: Priota Islam
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6bjhakn
materials: Terminal to connect to behavgenom Figure

steps.title: Clean glass plate
steps.instruction: Wipe the rectangular glass plate with ethanol using a lint‑free tissue.

steps.title: Power on and align rig
steps.instruction: Switch ON the rig using the back switch, then align the movable part to the desired position and lock it by pressing ON; to reposition later press EMO, twist the EMO knob and press ON again.

steps.title: Log in to PCs
steps.instruction: Log in to the three computers: PC1 (yellow label), PC2 (red label), and PC3 (blue label).

steps.title: Create dated data folder
steps.instruction: On PC1 only, navigate PC → Data Part 1 → Run script (init_exp.ps1) and create a new folder named with the current date in YYYYMMDD format (e.g., 20181011).

steps.title: Warm up rig
steps.instruction: Leave the rig ON for at least 15 minutes to allow the temperature to stabilize before any imaging.

steps.title: Start GECKO and set recording parameters
steps.instruction: On each PC, launch the GECKO software and configure:

substeps.instruction: Recording mode – select the desired duration.
Output video type – choose hdf5, mjpg, or other format as required.
Output folder – select the folder created in Step 4.
Camera selection – open the drop‑down beside the RECORD icon and choose ALL CAMERA for both cameras or CURRENT CAMERA for a single camera.

steps.title: Place worm plates on rig
steps.instruction: After selecting the desired number of worms, put the imaging plates on the rectangular glass plate beneath the cameras, with the open side down and lids removed, ensuring a thin agar layer.

steps.title: Check camera focus
steps.instruction: Zoom with the mouse on each camera (on each PC) and verify that the food ring is centered in the field of view.

steps.title: Acclimatize plates (optional)
steps.instruction: If the experiment requires, leave the worm‑containing plates on the rig for the specified acclimatization period; otherwise proceed to the next step.

steps.title: Start recording
steps.instruction: Press RECORD on all three PCs after all checks are complete.

steps.title: Adjust air table pressure (if needed)
steps.instruction: If the air table is not floating, turn the red knob parallel to the silver tube to let air in; when the pressure meter rises, turn the red knob perpendicular to the silver tube to isolate the compressed air.

steps.title: Enable autorepeat for long recordings (optional)
steps.instruction: When recording for multiple hours, select the autorepeat option in GECKO recording mode to prevent crashes and to split the video into shorter segments.

steps.title: Shut down rig and software
steps.instruction: Turn OFF the rig by turning the EMO knob and then closing the back switch; close GECKO on each PC (the camera light turns blue when closed successfully).

steps.title: Transfer data to network
steps.instruction: On each PC, run the script PC → Data Part 1 → Run script (move_files_anyPC.ps1) to copy the recorded files to the network share.

steps.title: Discard plates
steps.instruction: Remove and discard the imaging plates after data transfer.

steps.title: Handle Windows updates
steps.instruction: If any PC prompts for a Windows update, do not install it; contact the group’s responsible person or IT immediately.

steps.title: Reconnect shared drive (if disconnected)
steps.instruction: If the shared drive ‘behavgenom’ disconnects, double‑click move_files_anyPC.ps1, type CSCDOM\<your username> and press Enter, then type your password and press Enter to reconnect and resume file transfer.

steps.title: Recover from GECKO ‘Grabbing’ message
steps.instruction: If GECKO displays ‘Grabbing’, wait for the current recording to finish, then close GECKO and restart it before continuing to avoid dropped frames.

steps.title: Verify video files saved
steps.instruction: Open the destination folder and confirm that video files appear while or after recording.

steps.title: Start cameras in order (if independent)
steps.instruction: When starting cameras independently, begin with the back PC (PC3 – cameras 5 & 6) and then proceed forward to PC2 and PC1 (PC1 controls cameras 1 & 2, PC2 controls cameras 3 & 4).
